title: Write about your home
description: Describe your home and a place in your city.

items.prompt: Write 3 sentences about your home using there is / there are.
items.promptIt: Scrivi 3 frasi sulla tua casa usando there is / there are.

items.prompt: Write where one place in your city is.
items.promptIt: Scrivi dove si trova un posto nella tua città.
hints: There is a park next to...
